complete_private_file_inventory.scope: All regular files under the qualification directory, including auxiliary profile/cache/log files. Only allowlisted evidence hashes are listed individually.

limitations: Nine fresh startup component trials on one boot and host at maximum concurrency two do not establish long-running enterprise reliability.
The fixed sequence is descriptive; sequential/pair timing differences and stage variation do not establish a causal contention effect.
No employee tasks, learned-skill adaptation, inference response quality, live provider transport, learning gain, or six-world primary endpoint was tested.
Native initialization includes metadata activity and a built-in sandbox terminal probe; physical calls, tokens and cost were not independently metered.
Resource readbacks establish registered memory/swap/task/CPU boundaries. I/O isolation and bounded latency under arbitrary blocking operations remain unqualified.
Current absence is a separate read-only observation; original normal release, native wait, scope and cleanup receipts establish the recorded lifecycle.

definitions.child_close_phase_seconds: STARTUP_FINISHED to child close completion, including pre-close gate; not an isolated Computer.close measurement.
definitions.cleanup_charged_seconds: STARTUP_FINISHED through parent CLEANUP end, including pre-close gate, native close, witness, release, wait and final checks; bound30s.
definitions.computer_popen_to_ready_seconds: Native parent journal popen_returned through ready_received.
definitions.first_slot_start_to_final_slot_cleanup_s: Component span excludes registration, outer command setup and post-run audit. Concurrent slot durations must not be summed as wall time.
definitions.native_startup_phase_seconds: Native helper entry after initial boundary observation through STARTUP_FINISHED; includes computer/profile/skill setup and Computer.start.
definitions.setup_and_startup_charged_seconds: Slot INTENT start through STARTUP_FINISHED, including bootstrap, source/dependency checks and setup; bound150s.
definitions.worker_stages_seconds: Paired within-worker markers nested in startup; ready_write may finish after the parent first observes readiness.

usage.native_inference_interpretation: No inference requested in the reviewed startup-only call path with complete journals and disabled-loopback boundaries. This is source/boundary evidence, not a physical usage meter.
